result.notes: Official docs live at developers.binance.com (the old binance-docs.github.io hint 404s / has migrated). Credentials are obtained free via a standard Binance account: enable 2FA, make a spot-wallet deposit, and complete identity verification (KYC) — this is standard exchange onboarding rather than a partner/app-review gate, so classified as self_serve_free rather than admin_approval. No OAuth2 for the trading API itself (a separate OAuth-based 'Binance Connect'/account-linking flow exists for some partner integrations but is not the primary developer API auth). API surface spans spot, margin, futures, options, pay, and more — well over 300 endpoints combined, hence 'large'. No official vendor-published MCP server found; only community/unofficial implementations (e.g., nirholas/Binance-MCP, AnalyticAce/binance-mcp-server).
result.one_liner: Binance is a global cryptocurrency exchange offering REST/WebSocket APIs for spot, margin, futures, options, and pay/wallet operations.
